items.title: Trump administration makes it easier for companies to classify workers as contractors
items.summary: Nov 19 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump's administration unveiled a final rule on Thursday that will make it easier for companies in some industries to classify workers as ‌independent contractors rather than their employees, who have more legal protections and can cost more. The ‌Department of Labor scrapped a rule adopted during the administration of former President Joe Biden, a Democrat, and replaced it with a legal ​test favored by business groups.
